name: calendar-heatmap
title: Calendar heatmap
description: Daily matrix of reconciliation differences across groups and dates, with detailed field breakdown on click.
needs: A numeric measure, dates on records, and row grouping via group[0].

text.title: {left} against {right}, by {unitOne} and day
text.lede: A row per group, a column per day. Grey days agree within tolerance. Tinted days differ, in the colour of the side that is higher.
text.chartSub: Tolerance is {tolerance} per {unitOne}. Select a day for its breakdown.
text.noDates: Records need a date to be placed on the calendar. None were sent.

options.name: sortBy
options.description: Row order: as sent, largest absolute net difference first, or alphabetical.
